title: Identification and Functional Analysis of Human CD56neg NK Cells by Flow Cytometry
protocol: Add 10 mL of Ficoll Paque Plus to two conical 50 mL tubes.
Dilute the buffy coat 1:4 by adding sterile PBS and mix gently.
Carefully add 20 mL of the diluted buffy coat on top of the Ficoll in each conical tube.
Tilt the conical tube containing Ficoll.
Slowly add diluted buffy coat or whole blood to the tube by sliding it through the tube wall.
Centrifuge tubes at 800 × g for 20–25 min at 20°C–22°C.
Use low brake and acceleration during centrifugation.
Collect PBMC layer with a Pasteur pipette in a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 30 mL of sterile PBS to the collected PBMCs.
Centrifuge cells at 200 × g for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend pellet in 30 mL of sterile PBS.
Centrifuge samples at 300 × g for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Repeat the washing step with 30 mL of sterile PBS.
Resuspend the final pellet in 20 mL of sterile PBS.
Filter cells through 70 μm cell strainers.
Count viable cells by Trypan Blue exclusion.
Prepare cell cryopreservation medium.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend pellet in sterile FBS at a concentration of 500 μL/107 cells.
Place 500 μL of cells into each cryovial.
Add 500 μL of cell cryopreservation medium to reach a final volume of 1 mL per vial.
Store the cryovials in a freezing container at -80°C for 48 hours.
Transfer the vials to an appropriate storage container and store them in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw the cryovial in a water bath at 37°C.
Place the cells into a conical 15 mL tube.
Add 3 mL of RPMI medium (previously warmed at 37°C) to the cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of R10 medium.
Add DNase I from the stock solution to obtain a working concentration of 10U DNase I for up to 5 mL cell suspension.
Place the cells in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 h.
Centrifuge the tubes at 300–400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C (RT).
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of NK cell medium.
Filter the cell suspension with a 70 μm cell strainer and place it into a new 15 mL tube.
Count viable cells by Trypan Blue exclusion.
Add the appropriate volume of NK cell medium to obtain a concentration of 106 cells/mL if necessary.
Plate 0.5 × 10^6 thawed PBMCs in NK cell medium in a 48-well plate.
Add the appropriate volume of NK cell medium to obtain a final volume of 1 mL/well.
Add 10 ng/mL of IL-15 to all conditions.
Add 10 ng/mL of IL-12 and 50 ng/mL of IL-18 to the IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 stimulation condition.
Shake the plate very carefully by hand in a cross motion for 3 seconds to mix the wells.
Incubate the cells in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 until the next day.
Collect K562 cells from the 75 cm^3 flask used for their expansion and place them in a conical 15 mL tube.
Wash the cells with RPMI 1640 medium with L-Glutamine.
Centrifuge the cells at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C-22°C) and discard the supernatant.
Add RPMI 1640 medium with L-Glutamine to the cells.
Count viable K562 cells by Trypan Blue exclusion method.
Centrifuge the cells at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C-22°C) and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of NK cell medium to get a final concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Centrifuge the plate at 200 × g for 1 minute at 20°C–22°C with low brake and acceleration.
Carefully remove 250 μL of medium from the K562 cell line condition, avoiding PBMC detachment.
Add 250 μL (0.5 × 10^6 cells) of K562 cells to each well for a 1:1 E:T ratio.
Centrifuge the plate at 200 × g for 1 minute at 20°C–22°C with low brake and acceleration.
Add 20 μL/well of 1:10 diluted PE anti-CD107a monoclonal antibody to all wells except the unstained condition.
Shake the plate carefully by hand in a cross motion for 3 seconds to mix the wells.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 hour.
Individually add 0.66 μL/mL of monensin (GolgiStop) to all conditions.
Add 1 μL/mL of brefeldin A (GolgiPlug) to all conditions.
Shake the plate very carefully by hand, in a cross motion, for 3 seconds to mix the wells.
Incubate the plate in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 5 more hours.
Label cytometry tubes for each condition after the incubation period is over.
Pipette up and down the cell suspension and transfer it from each well into tubes.
Add 2 mL of PBS to each tube and centrifuge at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBS.
Reconstitute the LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Aqua Dead Cell Stain Kit reactivity dye by adding 50 μL of DMSO to the vial.
Mix well and visually confirm that all of the dye has dissolved.
Add 1 μL of the reactivity dye to all tubes except for the unstained condition.
Vortex the tubes after adding the reactivity dye.
Incubate the tubes on ice for 30 minutes, protecting from light.
Add 2 mL of cold PBS + BSA (2.5%) to all tubes.
Centrifuge at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in residual volume.
Prepare the antibody mix for extracellular staining according to Table 1.
Add the optimized volume of each antibody to the tubes.
Mix the antibodies with PBS + BSA (2.5%) before adding them to the tubes.
Incubate the samples on ice, protected from light, during the viability dye incubation period.
Use BD Brilliant Stain Buffer when using two or more antibodies conjugated with BD Horizon Brilliant fluorescence polymer dyes.
Add 77 μL of antibody mix to each tube, except for the unstained condition.
Vortex the tubes.
Incubate the tubes for 30 minutes on ice, protecting from light.
Add 2 mL of cold PBS + BSA (2.5%) to all tubes.
Centrifuge at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in the residual volume.
Prepare 150 μL/tube of 4% PFA by diluting 8% PFA stock buffer with PBS (1:2).
Add 140 μL/tube of 4% PFA to each tube.
Vortex the tubes.
Incubate for 15 minutes on ice, protecting from light.
Add 2 mL of cold PBS + BSA (2.5%) to all tubes.
Centrifuge at 300–400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in the residual volume.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of cold PBS + BSA (2.5%).
Vortex the tubes.
Place the tubes in the fridge (4°C) protected from light until next day.
Prepare 3.5 mL/tube of 1× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer by diluting the 10× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer with ddH2O.
Add 1 mL of 1× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer to all tubes and vortex.
Incubate for 15 min at 20°C–22°C (RT).
Protect from light during incubation.
Centrifuge the tubes at 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend pellet in residual volume.
Prepare an antibody mix according to the optimized volumes indicated.
Add 58 μL of antibody mix to each tube, except the unstained condition, and vortex.
Incubate for 30 min on ice.
Protect from light during incubation.
Add 2 mL of 1× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer to all tubes and centrifuge at 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with appropriate volume of PBS (200–400 μL) before acquiring samples in the flow cytometer.
Perform fluorescence compensation to correct the emission spectra overlap of different fluorochromes following the flow cytometer manufacturer’s recommendations.
Compensation can also be done after sample acquisition using various flow cytometry data analysis software.
